hero.subtitle: I'm an interaction designer and software developer based in Brisbane, Australia. I specialise in taking complex technical problems and looking at them through a user-first lens, with the goal of delivering polished, powerful and intuitive solutions.

intelligentAutofill.title: Building an AI Feature For Normal People
intelligentAutofill.description: Everybody has been drinking the AI Kool-Aid recently. In truth, so have I. It has completely revolutionised the kind of work I do and how I do it. I’m enthusiastic about how it can similarly revolutionise the work of non-nerd people in regular jobs, but AI is a complicated technology that is very tricky to neatly package up for regular people to use.

agenticAi.title: Agentic AI in 2026: The 3D Printer of Software
agenticAi.description: Fourteen months ago I was quite the AI sceptic, and by the middle of last year agentic AI had become embedded in how I work. Since then the magic has been wearing off. I still pay for Claude, but I justify it the way I justify my 3D printer: brilliant for little gizmos and quick prototypes, not for production parts.

formkit.title: FormKit: On Designing Forms for a Living
formkit.description: About eighteen months ago, I was tasked with rebuilding and uplifting all the forms across Insurebot — a system that became known internally as FormKit. What many would consider a rather mundane task turned out to be an excellent opportunity to deep-dive on how to design delightful and powerful forms for power users and novices alike.
